text:
elaine: Trying the node quickstart from the repo; my first call returns 402 Payment Required but the Console shows credits and a payment method on file. I expected a first successful call. Has anyone seen this mismatch?

devon: Which credential are you using — personal API key, org service account, or CI token? 402 usually means the request was flagged by gating. Can you paste the exact curl or SDK call (redact keys)?

elaine: curl output: `
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-ci-REDACTED\" \
 -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
 -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-4o-mini\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'
`

response body: `{\"error\":{\"code\":\"payment_required\",\"message\":\"Workspace requires billing or terms acceptance\"}}`

onboard-bot: Automated check: billing_status=active, payment_method=on_file, terms_accepted=false, admin_contact=elaine@example.com

sam_k: Ah — console shows billing active for the org but the service-account-level acceptance of terms (for machine tokens) is a separate flag. If terms_accepted=false onboard-bot will block non-interactive tokens.

luis: Also check that the request isn't being routed to a different workspace (header mismatch). If your CI token is scoped to workspace W123 but you pass an Org header or older SDK adds `X-Redwood-Org` it can hit a workspace with an unpaid gate.

devon: Quick checklist: 1) confirm token type (service account vs user) 2) run `GET /v1/workspaces/me` with the token to see which workspace it maps to 3) have an org admin accept terms in Console > Settings > Legal.

elaine: Ran `GET /v1/workspaces/me` and it returned workspace id W456, name: \"dev-team-ci\" and terms_accepted: false. I assumed creating the billing method auto-accepted everything.

luis: That's the confusion. Billing + payment_method != auto-accept of the new terms for HEADLESS tokens. We added the separate acceptance flag to make sure admins explicitly opt in for service accounts. UX gap for sure.

sam_k: Short-term workaround: an admin can toggle \"Allow service accounts to use org resources\" in Console -> Access, or click the banner to accept terms on behalf of the workspace. Long-term we should show that banner in the billing flow (file an issue).

elaine: Admin accepted the terms in Console. Retried the curl and got 200. First-call success. :party-parrot: Thanks all.

devon: Filed a tiny devex ticket to add a note in the quickstart README about service-account term acceptance and a console screenshot (ETA: next docs sprint).

luis: Adding a short SDK change suggestion — SDKs could surface a clearer error like `payment_required:terms_not_accepted` and include a console URL for admins.

elaine: Yep that would have saved ~20 minutes. Closing this thread.
